tex_content.html:
If pointed Ricci flows converge smoothly on compact subsets to a flow stochastically complete for $\square ^*$, their fundamental solutions converge smoothly on compact subsets after passing to a subsequence.
Proof

\sketch Use the uniform $L^1$ bound, parabolic regularity, and Fatou’s lemma; stochastic completeness forces the subsequential limit to equal the fundamental solution.

□

Lemma
[integral bound in pseudolocality]
